entries.subject: physics

entries.check: 寻找物理建模与推理转折

entries.subject: chemistry

entries.subject: chemistry
entries.check: 核查除杂真实可行区间

entries.subject: chemistry

entries.subject: chemistry
entries.check: 写明操作顺序、待判断的实测对象

entries.subject: biology
entries.check: 区分交感神经—髓质和垂体—皮质调节

entries.subject: biology
entries.check: 统计无必要的匿名对象

entries.subject: chinese

entries.subject: chinese
entries.check: 识别论证、叙述的转折

entries.subject: english
entries.check: 干扰项须对应原文中具体的误读

entries.subject: english
entries.check: 核查角色语域和具体语境

entries.check: 研究结论与观察须有可考的推断边界

entries.check: 检查文本、图例和刻度的渲染像素

entries.subject: chinese

entries.subject: chinese

entries.subject: english

entries.subject: english

entries.subject: english
entries.check: 听力及正文钟点用冒号，英文一级引文用双引号
